visual.name: codexKpiWall
visual.description: Multi-card KPI grid with auto-fit responsive layout, per-card accent driver, change pills, and subtle data-update shine animation.

en-US.Visual_Landing_Message: Add a Card label and a Headline value to begin.

dataRoles.name: headline
dataRoles.description: Primary value displayed prominently in each card

dataRoles.name: subtitle
dataRoles.description: Optional context line under the headline (e.g. 'vs last week')

dataRoles.name: change
dataRoles.description: Optional change/delta displayed as a pill

dataRoles.name: direction
dataRoles.description: Optional. -1 / 0 / 1 (or negative / zero / positive). Drives change pill colour and arrow.

dataRoles.name: accent
dataRoles.description: Optional. Hex string (e.g. #d4920a) or numeric driving palette index.

dataRoles.name: image
dataRoles.description: Optional URL or base64 data URL for a per-card image

dataRoles.name: widthSpan
dataRoles.description: Optional integer 1-12. How many grid columns this card spans (when Layout > Columns is a fixed number 6/12).

dataRoles.name: heightSpan
dataRoles.description: Optional integer 1-4. How many grid rows this card spans.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Extra fields shown in the hover tooltip
